summary: Regression-tested two changes: (1) StadiumStudio switch-classic-btn mobile-reachability fix and (2) BattleArena.js decomposition into useBattleRecorder hook + 3 view sub-components. All 10 in-scope scenarios PASS. 0 page errors, 0 same-key warnings across creator+gamer lane flows. Refactor is behavior-preserving.

test_results_detail.mobile_switch_classic_btn (375x800): PASS — element in DOM, visible (display:flex, box 91x28). Click switches to classic Record (switch-stadium-btn appears). pp_record_mode flow works on mobile.
test_results_detail.battle_arena_renders (1920x900, gamer): PASS — battle-arena, battle-stage-header, create-battle-btn, artist-marquee, stage-skin-toggle, leaderboard-section, active-battles all present.
test_results_detail.create_battle_no_song: PASS — Toast 'Select a song from Stream or Discover first!' displayed; no crash.
test_results_detail.battle_card_click_opens_stage: PASS — Clicking battle-card-{id} transitions away from battle-arena and renders data-testid='gamer-stage' (BattleArena view='stage' → GamerStage).
test_results_detail.stage_skin_toggle: PASS — Opens stage-skin-picker. 4 skins (theater/arena/space/ocean). Each click stores correct value in localStorage.pp_stage_skin (verified for 'theater'). Toast 'Stage skin: <Label>' fires.
test_results_detail.leaderboard_active_battles: PASS — both sections render (13 active battles in seeded data).
test_results_detail.battle_detail_submit_views: NOT EXERCISED via UI — per request note, openBattle routes directly to 'stage' (GamerStage). BattleDetailView (detail-back-btn / enter-battle-btn) and BattleSubmitView (battle-submit / rec-toggle-btn / username-input / rec-duration) are only reachable after a submitCover flow which itself requires reaching detail first. Code reviewed: testids preserved, props wiring is correct.
test_results_detail.full_app_regression_creator_nav: PASS — nav-home→home-page, nav-connect→connect-heading, nav-studio→koala-studio, nav-record→stadium-studio, nav-profile→social-profile (all 5).
test_results_detail.full_app_regression_gamer_nav: PASS — lane-toggle-gamer → battle-arena; nav-battle / nav-playlists / nav-backstage / nav-profile all clickable.
test_results_detail.pre_existing_warnings: 1 React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of option' — same as iteration_30 baseline, unrelated to this refactor.

critical_code_review_comments: BattleArena.js decomposition is clean: 188 lines, single-responsibility orchestrator (state + data loading + view dispatch). Delegates rendering to BattleStageListView/BattleDetailView/BattleSubmitView and mic logic to useBattleRecorder. All testids preserved.

useBattleRecorder.js is well-encapsulated (92 lines). Proper cleanup of stream tracks in onstop, timer cleared in stopRecording. Returns a stable API and a fmtDur helper. ONE MINOR: timerRef is not cleared on unmount of the consumer — if the consumer unmounts mid-recording, the interval will leak. Consider adding a useEffect cleanup that calls clearInterval(timerRef.current) and stops the MediaRecorder on unmount.

useBattleRecorder.playCoverAudio creates Audio objects via URL.createObjectURL but never revokes the blob URL when playback ends — minor memory leak per playback. Add URL.revokeObjectURL(url) in audio.onended.
StadiumStudio.js:365 fix is correct: class changed to 'inline-flex' (no sm: prefix). Verified visible at 375px viewport with display:flex computed style.
BattleArena.js: createBattle uses toast.info (not error) for the missing-song case — friendly UX choice, preserved from original. Spec wording 'should show toast' matches.

BattleArena.js: detail/submit views unreachable from a fresh list click because openBattle goes to 'stage' (GamerStage). This is the existing behavior (not a regression). The 'detail' view is only entered after submitCover() success. If the product intent is for users to vote on covers from the list, consider adding a 'View covers' affordance on each battle card that routes to the detail view — currently the BattleDetailView component renders only after the user has just submitted their own cover.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 testable scenarios PASS; 1 acknowledged unreachable via clean-UI)

test_credentials: localStorage: pp_lane (creator|gamer), pp_record_mode='stadium', sidetrack_voter_id='rec_test'. No auth required.
seed_data_creation: None — 13 active battles already seeded in DB.
